We want to find the number of ways to assign directions to the edges of the graph so that it is acyclic, i.e. contains no cycles. First, we investigate what the graph looks like. It can be easily seen that the graph consists of several connected components, where each component is either a path or a cycle with some paths connected to some of the vertices.
